title: UX STRATEGY
description: Experience vision, portfolio alignment and product strategy.
details: Aligning product roadmaps directly with validated user mental models and commercial ROI.
Translating ambiguous business objectives into defensible experience north stars.
Establishing executive design reviews that position UX as a top-line growth driver.

title: AI & INNOVATION
description: Human-centered AI, agentic experiences and design-led innovation.
details: Architecting human-in-the-loop interaction models for proactive generative systems.
Mitigating algorithmic hallucination anxiety through explainability and verification.
Designing multimodal spatial and agentic workflows beyond primitive conversational chat.

title: PEOPLE & ORGANIZATION
description: Building, mentoring and empowering high-performing UX teams.
details: Recruiting, developing, and retaining world-class multidisciplinary design talent.
Instituting a culture of intellectual rigor, mutual candor, and continuous craft excellence.
Structuring career pathways that bridge individual contributor craft and executive leadership.

title: TRANSFORMATION
description: Moving organizations from feature delivery toward experience-led development.
details: Shifting organizational posture from reactive ticket completion to holistic journey outcomes.
Embedding continuous qualitative and quantitative feedback loops directly into sprint cycles.
De-risking multi-million dollar platform replatforming initiatives through prototype testing.
